text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate detected for enterprise tenant Kapri in us-east-1 dedicated pool (kapri-dedicated). Error rate > 12% over 3m window. Paging oncall.
jules (oncall): ACK — I'm taking this. tagging devon and samir. Mobilizing runbook: /runbooks/kapri-dedicated-failover
devon (ops): On it. Pulling metrics and logs now, will check tracing and recent deploys. Can someone confirm if warm us-west capacity is still prewarmed for Kapri? @kai?
samir (sre): I see latency spikes on the cache layer: redis latency to 200-300ms in us-east. Traces show timeouts aligning with 504s. No recent deploys in last 2h.
kai (infra): Warm pool for Kapri is online in us-west-2 with KV cache prewarmed at ~95%. Autoscaler shows 6 warm nodes ready.
anya (csm): CSM on-call for Kapri is awake — I've pinged them. Customer-facing note: Kapri's platform team is monitoring; they want a rollback/failover update within 15m.
jules (oncall): Plan: 1) lower DNS TTL to 60s, 2) shift weighted traffic to us-west warm pool in staged canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%), 3) scale dedicated pool in us-east if necessary, 4) capture artifact/logs for RCA. Devon/samir/kai, please run steps and report.
devon (ops): Lowering TTL now and preparing weighted DNS change. Route53 TTL currently 300s.
devon (ops): Command I'm using (AWS CLI):
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z1234567890 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"kapri.example.com","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"us-east-1","Weight":80,"TTL":60,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"1.2.3.4"}]}}]}'
```
kai (infra): Scaling kapri-dedicated in us-east as precaution: `kubectl scale deploy/kapri-dedicated -n kapri --replicas=12`
kai (infra): scale started — pods creating, but if root cause is cache we may still see errors until traffic is moved.
incident-bot: Deploy bot: autoscaler event for kapri-dedicated: new replica set creating 6 pods (link: https://internal.builds/deploys/kapri/2107)
jules (oncall): Start canary at 10% to us-west-2. Watch latency, 5xx, and tail latencies for 5min windows. If stable, move to 50% then 100%.
samir (sre): Logs indicate a hot-shard on redis-us-east-1-1 — eviction and GC spikes. A patch is possible but riskier under current load. Failover safer.
devon (ops): Initiating weight update to route 10% to us-west. Route manager command:
```
traffic-manager set-weight --tenant kapri --region us-west-2 --weight 10
traffic-manager set-weight --tenant kapri --region us-east-1 --weight 90
```
devon (ops): Done. Canary started at 10% — monitoring.
jules (oncall): +:eyes: watching.
5m-checkpoint — devon (ops): 5xx down from 12% -> 6% globally. Latency p95 improved for canary traffic in us-west. No increased errors in us-west.
samir (sre): Correlation: almost all remaining 5xx originate from us-east cache shard. Read-only hits succeed, writes timeout.
anya (csm): CSM update to Kapri: "We've initiated a partial failover of customer traffic to an alternate region (non-disruptive). We'll continue to monitor and will provide another update in 15 minutes." They asked for ETA until full recovery.
jules (oncall): Next step: ramp to 50% in 10m if no regressions. Kai, can you validate prewarm cache size and any eviction counters in us-west to avoid overloading warm pool?
kai (infra): Confirmed. us-west warm KV cache headroom at ~70%, eviction rate normal. Ready to accept higher traffic.
devon (ops): Ramping to 50% now.
```
traffic-manager set-weight --tenant kapri --region us-west-2 --weight 50
traffic-manager set-weight --tenant kapri --region us-east-1 --weight 50
```
devon (ops): Ramp complete.
5m-checkpoint — devon (ops): Global 5xx now ~1.2% (big drop). Tail latency for requests routed to us-west stable. us-east still shows sporadic 504 spikes.
incident-bot: Alert: error-rate (us-east-1) degraded but overall tenant error-rate reduced to acceptable SLO.
samir (sre): RFC: keep weighted routing 80/20 (us-west/us-east) until we can patch redis and restore shard balance. Patch will require short maintenance; propose 02:00 UTC maintenance window. I'll start root-cause cleanup and plan.
jules (oncall): Good. Devon, please keep traffic at 80% us-west for now and coordinate with CSM for customer-approved maintenance window.
devon (ops): Setting weights to 80% -> us-west now.
```
traffic-manager set-weight --tenant kapri --region us-west-2 --weight 80
traffic-manager set-weight --tenant kapri --region us-east-1 --weight 20
```
devon (ops): Done. Monitoring: overall 5xx < 0.5% for the last 4m.
anya (csm): Kapri's ops lead confirmed maintenance window at 02:00 UTC. They requested a brief postmortem and timeline for full restoration.
kai (infra): I've also attached a short-term mitigation: increase read timeouts to reduce backpressure on cache clients in us-east. Will roll at low risk.
samir (sre): I captured heap GC traces and a few OOM hints from the cache process — RCA will include autosharding + client-side connection storms.
jules (oncall): OK. Incident severity reduced; keeping channel open for at least 2 hours while we run mitigation and handoffs.
jules (oncall): Handoff — I'm available for the next 30m, then devon takes primary until midnight PT. Samir will lead root cause and patch. Kai will own infra scaling and DNS orchestration.
devon (ops): I'll keep traffic at 80% us-west until patch. Noted on handoff. I'll update status page and the customer-facing incident note.
kapri-alerts-bot: Customer notification sent to Kapri ops slack and email (ticket #KAP-7893).
jules (oncall): Summary for the record: impact — elevated 5xx for Kapri due to cache hot-shard in us-east dedicated pool. Mitigation — staged DNS/traffic-weighted failover to prewarmed us-west region, scaled dedicated pool and tuned timeouts. Next steps — patch redis shard and rebalance, schedule maintenance at 02:00 UTC, postmortem/impact analysis assigned to samir. If anything changes ping here.
anya (csm): Thanks team — CSM to compile timeline and exec note. I'll update the customer.
samir (sre): Adding follow-ups to our backlog: #1 patch + verification, #2 improved shard monitoring, #3 automated cross-region failover doc.
jules (oncall): Closing active pager. Channel remains for updates. :white_check_mark:
